description: PERMANENTLY delete a recording: video, transcript, summary, key moments and comments. There is no trash and no undo. Only call this when the user explicitly asked to delete this specific recording, and repeat its id in `confirm`. Needs a key with recordings:delete (`clipy login --allow-delete`).

confirm.description: The recording's public id again. Must match `id` exactly.

id.description: The recording's public id (the slug in its share URL, e.g. 'a1b2c3d4e5f6') or the full https://clipy.online/video/<id> URL.

name: delete_recording
